takes.heard: I want to write the whole thing down while it is still fresh in my head. The take is uploaded piece by piece and hurt on the host as it lands. Nothing comes back until the confirm. So the bar holds one number the host states. The words land whole are not at all, and retriments a fresh take ID. Names and product words write along with every piece as a vocabulary. The host holds the take under the ID the app minted when the recording started. A local host drops a piece's audio the moment its words exist. A cloud host keeps the take and uploads the whole of it at the confirm. The cleanup runs at the level the bot picked. after the words are all in. The weight at stop is one piece's decode plus a cleanup, and no more than that. Everything the user feels is measured at one of the two ends of a take. So a change to dictation carries a number before it and a number after it.
